a: परिसंख्या — {c2c} P. 1 To count or reckon up, add together. --2 To enumerate.

परिसंख्या — 1 Enumeration, computation. --2 Sum, total, number; वित्तस्य विद्यापरिसंख्यया मे R. 5. 21. --3 (In Mīm. phil.) Exclusion, specification, limitation to that which is enumerated or expressly mentioned, so that everything else is excluded; (परिसंख्या is opposed to विधि which lays down a rule for the first time, and to नियम which restricts the choice to an alternative which is expressly stated when several such alternatives are possible); विधिरत्यंतमप्राप्तौ नियमः पाक्षिके सति . तत्र चान्यत्र च प्राप्तौ परिसंख्येति गीयते .. e. g. पंच पंचनखा भक्ष्याः usually quoted by the Mīmāṃsakas; अयं नियमविधिर्न तु परिसंख्या Kull. on Ms. 3. 45. --4 (In Rhet.) Special mention or exclusive specification, i. e. where with or without a query something is affirmed for the denial, expressed or understood, of something else similar to it; (this figure is particularly striking when it is based on a श्लेष or pun); यस्मिन् महीं शासति चित्रकर्मसु वर्णसंकराश्चापेषु गुणच्छेदाः &c. or यस्य नूपुरेषु मुखरता विवाहेषु करग्रहणं तुरंगेषु कशाभिघातः &c. K; for other examples see S. D. 735. --5 Recapitueation.
